data.name: Joaziel
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Joaziel is derived from two roots: YHWH (God) and Zavel (strength or help). The name Joaziel means 'God is strong'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and power of God in one's life.
data.numerology_meaning: The Master Number 11 symbolizes illumination, vision, and intuition.

in_hebrew.name: יוазаאל
in_hebrew.meaning: אל הוא מקלטי - אל הוא מחסן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם 'יוазаאל' מורכב מיו' ה' אלוקים ומאזל שפירושו להחזיר או להושיע. על כן, פירוש השם הוא 'אל הוא מקלטי' או 'אל הוא מחסן', ומבטא את הרעיון של אלוהים כמקור הביטחון והישועה.

in_greek.name: Ιωαζιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα 'Ιωαζιήλ' προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'יו' και 'אזל', που σημαίνουν 'ο Θεός' και 'απευθύνεται' ή 'σώζει'. Έτσι, το όνομα σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι καταφύγιό μου' και εκφράζει την ιδέα του Θεού ως πηγή προστασίας και σωτηρίας.

in_latin.name: Joaziel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Joaziel' derivatur ex hebraicis vocibus 'יו' et 'אזל', quae significant 'Deus' et 'refugium' vel 'salvare'. Itaque, nomen significat 'Deus est mea tutela' et exprimit ideam Dei ut fontem protectionis et salvationis.

in_english.name: Joaziel
in_english.meaning: God is my refuge or God saves
in_english.long_meaning: The name 'Joaziel' originates from Hebrew roots 'יו' (Yah) and 'אזל' (azal), meaning 'God' and 'to return' or 'to save'. Thus, it signifies 'God is my refuge' or 'God saves', conveying the concept of God as a source of protection, salvation, and security. Historically, the name reflects the biblical theme of seeking divine shelter and deliverance.

biblical_reference.note: Joaziel is mentioned as one of the leaders of the Reubenites in 1 Chronicles 15:8.

data.cultural_impact: The name Joaziel has been recorded in the Old Testament, most notably among its bearers were two individuals - a Levite priest under King Uzzah (1 Chronicles 25:2) and a priest living during the reign of King Hezekiah (Isaiah 8:2). This name thus bears a historical and religious significance for its carriers with deep-rooted biblical connections.
data.spiritual_significance: As a name rooted in faith and trust in God's power, Joaziel embodies the idea of seeking divine strength and support in challenging times. The spiritual significance of this name can be a constant reminder to the bearer of their dependence on God. Its true meaning; "God is strong," can provide comfort and courage in moments of doubt, fear, or hardship. To embrace the name Joaziel is to live with the understanding that, no matter the circumstances, God's strength and sustaining power will carry you through.

historical_references.reference: Joaziel is mentioned in the apocryphal Book of Jubilees as the angel who interprets dreams for Jacob and his family. This text dates to the late second temple period, around 135 BCE to 70 CE.
historical_references.time_period: Late Second Temple Period (135 BCE to 70 CE)
historical_references.context: Interprets dreams for Jacob and his family

historical_references.reference: In the Book of Enoch, Joaziel is the angel who delivers the prophecy of the birth and destiny of John the Baptist to Zacharias and Elizabeth. This text dates to the second century BCE.
historical_references.context: Delivers prophecy of John the Baptist's birth and destiny to Zacharias and Elizabeth
